plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published in the 2023-2024 catalog (pp. 103-104), including Summer terms. Lower bound used for ENGL 1A/1AS (4 or 5) -> ENGL 1A 4 units. Sequenced lower bounds sum to 64. Hard prerequisites from the catalog's degree requirements notes are coded and satisfied in sequence order: ATECH 24A requires ATECH 11 ('Atech 11 is a prerequisite for Atech 24[A]'); ATECH 14 requires ATECH 11 and ATECH 12; ATECH 27 requires ATECH 24A. Catalog program rule (documented, not a sequence constraint): students may not take more than one 10-unit 'major' course (ATECH 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 40, 41, 42, 45) in a single semester — the sequence complies. The sequence substitutes MATH 15 for the MATH 225 in the requirements, with footnote 'Students can choose to take any other degree applicable math course' — kept verbatim as Major per the REQUIREMENT column. Category mapping: 'GE' -> core, 'Major' -> major, 'Elective' -> elective. ATECH 27 prerequisite discrepancy documented: the Engine Performance degree-requirements page states 'Atech 24A is a prerequisite for Atech 27', while the ATECH 27 course description (p. 127) lists 'Prerequisite: ATECH 21'. Both are coded; both are satisfied in-sequence. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
